headline_marked: [[Voice-driven murder mystery]] lets you interview AI suspects
headline: Voice-driven murder mystery lets you interview AI suspects
summary: Step into the interrogation room and catch AI suspects' lies. Solve the murder at Blackwood Manor using your own voice.
details: A new voice-driven murder mystery game allows players to interrogate AI suspects using their own voice. The game, titled 'Death at Blackwood Manor', challenges players to uncover the truth by questioning virtual characters and identifying the killer.

Players can directly speak to the AI characters, asking questions and detecting inconsistencies in their stories. The game aims to provide an immersive detective experience where vocal interaction is key to solving the crime.

The narrative centers around a poisoned patriarch and five guests, all locked in a manor with a murderer among them. Players must piece together clues and use their conversational skills to accuse the correct suspect.
This innovative use of AI technology offers a unique approach to interactive storytelling and gaming, pushing the boundaries of how players can engage with virtual environments and characters.
